opening.text: I'm here because I've been feeling nauseous, like I might vomit, and I have pain. I've also noticed my stools are pale and my urine is dark. I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful. By the way, I have chronic pancreatitis, I'm quite overweight for my height, and someone in my family has been diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.
